brief: A young queen in a deep-red sari asleep on a low bed in a lamp-lit palace chamber, one hand on her belly; at the foot of the bed, a tall figure of matted hair, ash-smeared body and a crescent moon, smiling kindly with a trident held loosely, as if in a dream; moonlight through lattice windows.

A palace lying-in chamber with latticed windows and lamps; a young queen in deep red lying back with a tired smile, a tiny baby in saffron cloth in her arms; a handsome king in pale gold bending over them, wonder and joy on his face; a soft glow around the baby.

A palace courtyard at dusk; the king holding up his baby son in saffron cloth toward the open sky, the queen beside him; pale flower petals falling from above like rain; drummers on the rooftops; lamps lit along the walls; a faint luminous cloud above the courtyard where a voice seems to come from.

A sunlit palace garden beside a lotus pool; a small laughing child in saffron playing with six boys of different sizes in plain bright clothes, a ball and a toy cart on the grass; a king and a queen watching from a pillared verandah, smiling; a glowing palm leaf resting on the verandah rail.
